description.en:
Marks the deadwood trees that an active contract actually requires.
Deadwood contracts give you a circle on the map, and in the world only a small sprayed mark on each trunk that you cannot see until you are already standing at the tree. This mod fills the gap between the two: every tree the contract counts gets a marker above it, visible across the stand, and trees that are off-screen get an arrow at the edge of the screen pointing the way. A readout shows how many are left and how far the nearest one is.
Only trees belonging to a contract you are actually running are marked, and a tree's marker disappears the moment you finish the cut. Trees that merely look dead, and normal trees standing among them, are ignored — the tree list comes from the contract itself, not guessed from the tree.
Multiplayer supported: markers are drawn locally for each player, and everyone in the farm that holds the contract sees them. Nothing is sent over the network.
Toggle with Ctrl+D.
